facilityType: A premier health and rehabilitation center
description: We are seeking a dedicated and experienced Assistant Director of Nursing (ADON) to join a premier health and rehabilitation center in Missouri Valley, IA. This is a permanent, full-time opportunity for a professional committed to long-term engagement and making a significant impact on patient care and staff development. We are specifically looking for candidates seeking a stable, non-interim position.In this vital leadership role, the ADON will support the Director of Nursing in overseeing clinical operations, ensuring high standards of patient care, and fostering a positive and productive work environment. Responsibilities include clinical supervision, staff training, regulatory compliance, and contributing to quality improvement initiatives.If you are an RN with a passion for leadership in a skilled nursing setting and are looking for a permanent home where your expertise will be valued, we encourage you to apply. Join a team dedicated to excellence and compassionate care.
requirements: Active Registered Nurse (RN) license in the state of Iowa.
Minimum of 2-3 years of nursing experience in a skilled nursing or long-term care facility.
Prior leadership experience in a healthcare setting, such as ADON, Supervisor, or Charge Nurse.
Strong clinical assessment, critical thinking, and communication skills.
Commitment to a permanent, full-time position; interim candidates will not be considered.
